extDescription.message: Hand repetitive web chores to Hibi. Turn it on one site at a time; every submit waits for your approval.

askPlaceholder.message: What should I do on this page?

signInIntro.message: Hibi does repetitive chores on the sites you choose: filling forms, copying details across pages, clicking through lists. Sign in with your Hibira account to start. The free plan includes monthly tasks.

unsupportedPage.message: Open a website in this tab to use Hibi here.

siteOffIntro.message: Hibi is off for $1. Turn it on to let Hibi read and work on this site. You can turn it off any time.

hello.message: Hi, I'm Hibi. Tell me what to do on $1. I leave sign-in pages and robot checks to you, and I ask before anything is submitted.

allowanceUsed.message: You have used this month's tasks. Open Plan and usage to add more.

needInvoke.message: To use Hibi on this tab, click the Hibi button in the toolbar, press Alt+Shift+H, or right-click the page and choose "Use Hibi on this site".

signInFailed.message: Sign-in didn't finish. Please try again.

chooseFolder.message: Let Hibi use a folder on this computer
